atrLen = input(14, "ATR Length", 2, 60, 1)
rangeLen = input(20, "Range Length", 5, 100, 1)
vovLen = input(20, "Vol-of-Vol Length", 3, 60, 1)
coilLookback = input(100, "Coil Lookback", 20, 300, 1)
releaseMult = input(1.5, "Release Mult", 1.1, 4.0, 0.1)
coilThresh = input(0.35, "Coil Threshold", 0.05, 0.95, 0.05)
predLen = input(20, "Predictability Length", 2, 60, 1)
predThresh = input(0.55, "Predictability Threshold", 0.1, 0.9, 0.05)
markerSize = input(1.0, "Marker Size", 0.2, 3.0, 0.1)

atrVal = atr(high, low, close, atrLen)
rng = high - low
rngMax = highest(rng, rangeLen)
rangeCoil = rng / max(rngMax, 0.0001)
atrMax = highest(atrVal, rangeLen)
atrCoil = atrVal / max(atrMax, 0.0001)
vov = stdev(atrVal, vovLen)
vovRise = vov / max(vov[1], 0.000001)
coilRaw = (2.0 - rangeCoil - atrCoil) / 2.0 * vovRise
coilMax = highest(coilRaw, coilLookback)
coilLoaded = coilRaw / max(coilMax, 0.000001)
chg = change(close)
absChg = abs(chg)
predDen = sma(absChg, predLen) * predLen
predNum = abs(sma(chg, predLen) * predLen)
predRead = predNum / max(predDen, 0.000001)
relExp = rng / max(rng[1], 0.0001)
atrTurn = atrVal / max(atrVal[1], 0.000001)
hhPrev = highest(high, rangeLen)[1]
llPrev = lowest(low, rangeLen)[1]
isPred = predRead > predThresh
warmup = bar_index > coilLookback
buyRaw = warmup and coilLoaded > coilThresh and relExp > releaseMult and atrTurn > 1.0 and close > hhPrev
sellRaw = warmup and coilLoaded > coilThresh and relExp > releaseMult and atrTurn > 1.0 and close < llPrev
buySig = buyRaw and not buyRaw[1]
sellSig = sellRaw and not sellRaw[1]
relHeight = relExp * coilLoaded

if buySig { plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "triangleup", "#22cc88") }
if sellSig { plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "triangledown", "#ff4477") }
if buySig { barcolor("#22cc88") }
if sellSig { barcolor("#ff4477") }
if buySig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, low, "Buy Release", "coneup", "#22cc88", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if sellSig { plotshape_3d(bar_index, high, "Sell Release", "conedown", "#ff4477", markerSize, 0, "separate") }
if buySig and isPred { label3d(bar_index, high, "Predictable", "#22cc88", 1, 1, "separate") }
if sellSig and isPred { label3d(bar_index, low, "Predictable", "#ff4477", 1, 1, "separate") }
if coilLoaded > coilThresh { bgcolor("#1c2a4a") }

plot(coilLoaded, "Coil Loaded", "#22aaff", 2, "separate")
plot(predRead, "Predictability", "#ffd43b", 2, "separate")
hline(coilThresh, "#22aaff", "separate")
hline(predThresh, "#ffd43b", "separate")
plot3d(coilLoaded, "Coil Loaded 3D", "ribbon", "#22aaff", "separate", 0)
plot3d(predRead, "Predictability 3D", "line3d", "#ffd43b", "separate", 1)
plot3d(relHeight, "Release Expansion 3D", "bars3d", "#ff8833", "separate", 2)

SessionLength = input(20, "Session Length", 10, 100, 1)
HTFTimeframe = input("1h", "HTF Timeframe")
HTFLookback = input(20, "HTF Lookback", 5, 100, 1)
MinConfidence = input(60, "Min Confidence", 0, 100, 1)
HardStopPoints = input(30.0, "Hard Stop Points", 1.0, 200.0, 0.5)

SessionHigh = highest(high, SessionLength)
SessionLow = lowest(low, SessionLength)
sessHighPrev = SessionHigh[1]
sessLowPrev = SessionLow[1]
sessWidth = SessionHigh - SessionLow
avgWidth = sma(sessWidth, 10)

htfH = security("1h", high)
htfL = security("1h", low)
htfC = security("1h", close)
htfO = security("1h", open)

HTFHigh = highest(htfH, HTFLookback)
HTFLow = lowest(htfL, HTFLookback)
htfHighPrev = HTFHigh[1]
htfLowPrev = HTFLow[1]
prevRange = htfHighPrev - htfLowPrev

bullConf = htfC > htfHighPrev
bearConf = htfC < htfLowPrev
confirmed = bullConf or bearConf

breakDist = bullConf ? htfC - htfHighPrev : bearConf ? htfLowPrev - htfC : 0
extensionBonus = breakDist > 0.25 * prevRange ? 20 : 0
widthBonus = sessWidth > avgWidth ? 15 : 0

topBody = htfC > htfO ? htfC : htfO
botBody = htfC > htfO ? htfO : htfC
upperWick = htfH - topBody
lowerWick = botBody - htfL
wickNow = bullConf ? upperWick : bearConf ? lowerWick : 0
wickPenalty = breakDist > 0 and wickNow > breakDist ? -30 : 0

confBase = confirmed ? 50 : 0
confRaw = confirmed ? confBase + extensionBonus + widthBonus + wickPenalty : 0
confHigh = confRaw > 100 ? 100 : confRaw
confidence = confHigh < 0 ? 0 : confHigh

var pos = 0
var entryPx = 0.0

rawBuyBreak = crossover(close, sessHighPrev) and bullConf and confidence >= MinConfidence
rawSellBreak = crossunder(close, sessLowPrev) and bearConf and confidence >= MinConfidence
buySig = rawBuyBreak and pos == 0
sellSig = rawSellBreak and pos == 0

longStop = entryPx - HardStopPoints
shortStop = entryPx + HardStopPoints
longStopHit = pos == 1 and crossunder(close, longStop)
longSupBreak = pos == 1 and crossunder(close, sessLowPrev)
longOpp = pos == 1 and rawSellBreak
longExitSig = pos == 1 and (longStopHit or longSupBreak or longOpp)
shortStopHit = pos == -1 and crossover(close, shortStop)
shortResBreak = pos == -1 and crossover(close, sessHighPrev)
shortOpp = pos == -1 and rawBuyBreak
shortExitSig = pos == -1 and (shortStopHit or shortResBreak or shortOpp)

if buySig {
    model.confidence(confidence / 100)
    model.stopLoss(HardStopPoints, "abs")
    model.longEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Buy", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
    pos := 1
    entryPx := close
}
if sellSig {
    model.confidence(confidence / 100)
    model.stopLoss(HardStopPoints, "abs")
    model.shortEntry("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Sell", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    pos := -1
    entryPx := close
}
if longExitSig {
    model.longExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
    pos := 0
    entryPx := 0.0
}
if shortExitSig {
    model.shortExit("siege")
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Exit", "diamond", "#ffcc00")
    pos := 0
    entryPx := 0.0
}

plot(SessionHigh, "Session High", "#ff4477", 1, "stepline")
plot(SessionLow, "Session Low", "#22cc88", 1, "stepline")

max_speed_for_color = input(50.0, "Max Speed Color", 10.0, 100.0, 1.0)

m = sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)

xn = mSafe * (x / (m + 0.000001)) + (1 - mSafe) * 1.0
yn = mSafe * (y / (m + 0.000001)) + (1 - mSafe) * 0.0
zn = mSafe * (z / (m + 0.000001)) + (1 - mSafe) * 0.0

horiz = sqrt(xn * xn + yn * yn)

rangeC = max_speed_for_color - min_speed_for_color

Gval = 0.2 + t * 0.45
Bval = 1.0 - t * 0.8

var lockBars = 0.0
var lastOverBar = -1000.0
var lastClearBar = -1000.0

gatedOver = overEvent and (bar_index - lastOverBar[1] > sigCool)
gatedClear = clearEvent and (bar_index - lastClearBar[1] > sigCool)

if locked {
    lockBars := lockBars[1] + 1
    disc_angle := disc_angle[1]
}
if not locked {
    lockBars := 0.0
    disc_angle := disc_angle[1] + spin_speed * 0.5
}
if gatedOver {
    lastOverBar := bar_index
}
if gatedClear {
    lastClearBar := bar_index
}
if gatedOver {
    plotshape(bar_index, high, "OVERPRESSURE", "triangledown", "#ff4477")
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, ringPrice1, "Shock1", "torus", "#ff4477", ringSize1, 1, "separate", 90, disc_angle, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, ringPrice2, "Shock2", "torus", "#ff8844", ringSize2, 2, "separate", 90, disc_angle, 0)
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, ringPrice3, "Shock3", "torus", "#ffcc44", ringSize3, 3, "separate", 90, disc_angle, 0)
    label3d(bar_index, high + 5, "OVERPRESSURE", "#ff4477", 1, 4, "separate")
}
if gatedClear {
    plotshape(bar_index, low, "Normal", "triangleup", "#22cc88")
}
if discTick {
    plotshape_3d(bar_index, close, "ValveDisc", "torus", discColor, discSize, 0, "separate", 0, disc_angle, 0)
}

plot(flow_psi, "Flow PSI", "#33ccff", 2)
hline(crit, "#ff4477")
plot(spin_speed, "Spin Speed", "#ffcc44", 1)
plot3d(flow_psi, "Flow PSI 3D", "ribbon", "#33ccff", "separate")
plot3d(spin_speed, "Spin Speed 3D", "torus", "#ffcc44", "separate", 1)
